# IT Security Protocol and Monitoring Standards

This document details essential security and monitoring tasks for the IT department.

*   Monitor the encryption standards for strategy 2026.
*   Investigate the API latency quarterly.
*   Investigate the encryption standards urgently.
*   Investigate the firewall settings quarterly.
*   Review the firewall settings standard update.
